Moon Active is one of the world's top mobile game companies, our teams leverage cutting-edge technologies to craft fun and interactive games enjoyed by millions worldwide. We produce exciting and engaging entertainment for players across the globe and pride ourselves on developing top-quality casual games that invite and allow players to connect with one another.

We are looking for an experienced Unity Developer with an AI-first mindset to build next-gen gaming features. You will join a team of engineers building high-scale, real-time game systems, leveraging LLMs for complex logic, automating workflows, and using AI agents to continuously improve how we build.

Requirements

- Proficiency in software development.

- Hands-on experience with Claude Code, Cursor or similar.

- Experience with object-oriented programming, including design patterns, algorithms, and data structures.

- Strong knowledge of an OOP language (C# or equivalent) and memory management.

- Proactive, self-driven, with strong communication skills.

- Experience with Unity on mobile platforms, including its scripting APIs, profiling tools, UI, and animations.

Responsibilities

- Manage features from system design and data handling to production deployment.

- Design architectures and implement end-to-end client-side features, leveraging LLMs from day-to-day development processes up to system architecture.

- Use data-driven methods to resolve production issues and optimize performance across all devices.

- Manage the integration of native plugins and third-party services.

Advantages

- AI engineering - experience in building agentic & autonomous frameworks.

- Experience working in a high scale data driven environment - firebase, analytics, metrics etc.
